title: 9 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Eye Infection
intro: Herbal essential oils for Eye infection are highly concentrated plant extracts used to treat and soothe eye infections, which are characterized by inflammation, redness, and discharge in the eyes. These oils offer numerous benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial and fungal infections, and promoting healing. Some examples of herbal essential oils used to treat eye infections include tea tree oil, known for its antimicrobial properties; lavender oil, which helps reduce inflammation and promotes relaxation; chamomile oil, used to soothe and calm the eyes; and eucalyptus oil, which helps reduce swelling and congestion. Additionally, other oils such as frankincense oil, geranium oil, and calendula oil are also used to treat eye infections due to their antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis essential oils, derived from the marigold flower, have been traditionally used to treat eye infections such as conjunctivitis and blepharitis due to their anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis, including triterpenoids and sesquiterpenes, help to reduce inflammation and combat bacterial and fungal infections in the eyes. By treating the underlying causes of eye infections, Calendula officinalis essential oils can help to alleviate symptoms such as redness, swelling, and discharge, ultimately promoting the healing and recovery of the affected area. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis essential oils for eye infections include reduced risk of complications, faster healing times, and a decrease in the reliance on antibiotics and other medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Calendula officinalis essential oils have potential therapeutic effects for ophthalmological problems, specifically deserving attention for further research due to its effectiveness against eye infections.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus essential oils have been used to treat eye infection ailments due to their antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Eucalyptus globulus essential oils, such as cineole and limonene, play a crucial role in fighting off infection-causing pathogens and soothing irritated tissues. Regular use of Eucalyptus globulus essential oils has been shown to provide relief from eye infections, reduce the risk of complications, and promote a speedy recovery.

Regular use of Aloe barbadensis essential oils has been reported to provide relief from eye infections, reduce inflammation, and promote healthy vision, making it a popular natural remedy for this common ailment.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of parasitic diseases : official organ of the Indian Society for Parasitology", Aloe barbadensis essential oils (specifically its ethanol extract) have shown potent cysticidal activity against Acanthamoeba cysts, a common cause of eye infection, and may be a promising treatment option for Acanthamoeba keratitis.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils did exhibit an IC50 ≤32 microg/ml for biofilm inhibition against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), which is a common cause of skin and soft tissue infection (SSTI).

intro_study: According to "BMC complementary and alternative medicine", essential oils for eye infection, specifically thyme red oil, pine oil, and their components carvacrol, thymol, and α-pinene, have shown good activity against Candida albicans, which can cause eye infections, including fluconazole/voriconazole resistant strains.
